title: (Lore Accurate) Dagoth Ur Follower Bios
tagline: Character Bio for self-aware Dagoth Ur companion who roasts Skyrim, the player, and the limits of immersion/patience.
description: A hand-written SkyrimNet character bio for Dagoth Ur from (LORE ACCURATE) Dagoth Ur Follower.
